    # m = 2. S_m = {1, ..., 50}. T is the set of edges of C_50.
    
    # 1. Define the vertices and edges for C_50
    N = 50
    T = []
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        # Edge between i and i+1 (mod N)
        j = (i % N) + 1
        T.append(frozenset({i, j}))

    # 2. Check constraints
    
    # (a) Check subset size
    m = 2
    all_size_m = all(len(t) == m for t in T)
    
    # (b) Check pairwise intersection <= 1
    pairwise_intersection_ok = True
    for i in range(len(T)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(T)):
            intersection = len(T[i].intersection(T[j]))
            if intersection > 1:
                pairwise_intersection_ok = False
                break
        if not pairwise_intersection_ok:
            break
            
    # (c) Check coverage (each element in S_m is contained in exactly two elements of T)
    coverage = {}
    for element in range(1, N + 1):
        coverage[element] = 0
        
    for subset in T:
        for element in subset:
            coverage[element] += 1
            
    all_coverage_two = all(coverage[e] == 2 for e in range(1, N + 1))

    print(f"Total elements in T: {len(T)}")
    print(f"Constraint (a) (Size m=2): {all_size_m}")
    print(f"Constraint (b) (Pairwise intersection <= 1): {pairwise_intersection_ok}")
    print(f"Constraint (c) (Coverage == 2): {all_coverage_two}")
